metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the licence, the seven shillings, the carrier, and Anne's letter on the stair.

yesterday: Tilney signed the last leaf. The other play is to be let alone in Shoreditch.
Seven shillings is paid, and Heminges has entered it once. A clean licence is the kind he says he can afford.
The letter of the 26th has gone down. Gilbert was at the Bell and has gone back to St Bride's. Anne's letter was on the stair at home.
Anne has set the winter wash at fourpence a week, already paid. You did not answer her today.
The afternoon went to the licence, and then to the Bell.
